title: Ya abbas
body:
Tanha hai koi fauj hai betaab
mashkeeza liye kaise bujhe pyaas
ya abbas..(4) abbas
ya abbas..(4)
ya abbas..(4)
tanha hai koi..
<<DIVIDER>>
1. {Khaimo me lagi aag to zainab ne pukara
bus ek tuhi tanha hai chadar ka sahara} ..(2)
tanha hai koi..
<<DIVIDER>>
2. {Aa neher se ek baar ke jaa tujhko me waaru
du tujhko duae tera sadqa mai utaru}.. (2)
tanha hai koi..
<<DIVIDER>>
3. {Aaegi hume lootne jab shame ghareeba
mai dekhungi naize pe sare shahe shaheeda} ..(2)
tanha hai koi..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. {Chhaa jaega jab shaam ghareeba ka andhera
aur hoga mere baazu pe jab rassi ka ghera} ..(2)
tanha hai koi..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. {Kat jaega jab tegh se har aankho ka taara
chhin jaega mujhse mera har ek sahara} ..(2)
tanha hai koi
<<DIVIDER>>
6. {Ye aaj bhi jungle me sada goonj rahi hai
zainab ki ye maqtal me sada goonj rahi hai} ..(2)
tanha hai koi...
ya abbas..(8)
